title: NAT
saved: Saved to the candidate. Commit to apply it.
readonly: Your role can view but not change NAT.

status.label: NAT44-ED status on the data plane
status.truncated: counts stopped at the agent's scan limit

outbound.intro: Source NAT (PAT) of inside hosts to the pool addresses on the outside interfaces (VPP nat44-ed). Traffic that matches no pool is dropped unless forwarding is on. Changes go to the candidate and apply on Commit.

enabled.title: NAT44
enabled.help: Automatic = on as soon as interfaces, pools or mappings are configured

mode.title: Mode
mode.help: ed = endpoint-dependent (applied by this build); ei = endpoint-independent

forwarding.title: Forwarding
forwarding.help: Forward traffic that matches no NAT session instead of dropping it

sessionLimit.title: Session limit
sessionLimit.help: Max sessions per worker thread; empty = VPP default

list.conflict: This entry changed in the candidate since the list was loaded (another session). Nothing was saved; the list shows the current candidate.

static.intro: 1:1 NAT (no ports) and port forwards (protocol + ports), identity mappings (never translated) and load-balanced port forwards.
static.title: Static mappings & port forwards

pools.intro: Outside addresses: an IPv4 range (optionally for one VRF) or the address of an interface (follows DHCP). Adjacent ranges of one VRF must be written as one range.
pools.title: Address pools
pools.orphans: Pools on the data plane that the running configuration does not have:

sessions.intro: Live NAT44-ED sessions from the data plane, paged by the server. Deleting a session drops that translation; the next packet of the flow creates a new one.
sessions.title: NAT sessions

kill.title: Delete NAT session?
kill.question: The translation is removed from the data plane now (audited). The flow's next packet creates a new session.
kill.gone: The session no longer exists (it expired or was deleted already).
kill.unsupported: Only TCP, UDP and ICMP sessions can be deleted here
